name: John Sechler
bio: John Sechler, known as "Arkansas John," was a freighter of 26 years whose mule train could haul 100,000 pounds and who arrived at Medora in late May 1884. The paper cited him in July 1884 as one of the freighters who called the Medora route to the Black Hills the best.
